asks: There is no way to delete a Task, and no way to move a Task from one Project to another. Should the glossary specify these operations, and if so, which?
because: Task belongs to exactly one Project ("A Task belongs to exactly one Project; a Project may hold any number of Tasks, including none" — Project) and the only function that reaches Task is completeTask and reopenTask, neither of which removes it or reassigns its project attribute. The gap is already visible in q-004's third option, which notes that "nothing in the glossary currently deletes a Task or moves it between Projects, so as it stands the Project is unreachable rather than merely protected" — a Project blocked by an undeletable RecurringTask has no spec'd way out short of deleting the whole Project.

options.label: Spec both deleteTask and moveTask
options.detail: Closes both gaps. Gives a caller a way to remove a single Task without deleting its Project, and a way to reassign a Task's Project without deleting and recreating it. Also gives q-004's blocked-Project scenario an actual escape route.

ops.spec: Deletes a single Task, removing it from its Project.
Reassigns a Task from its current Project to a different Project.

tests: deleteTask removes the target Task from its Project's tasks list
moveTask changes target.project to destination and updates both Projects' tasks lists

options.label: Spec deleteTask only
options.detail: A Task can be removed outright, but reassigning it to another Project remains outside the vocabulary — the only way to change a Task's Project stays delete-and-recreate.

ops.spec: Deletes a single Task, removing it from its Project.

tests: deleteTask removes the target Task from its Project's tasks list

options.label: Spec moveTask only
options.detail: A Task can be reassigned to another Project, but there is still no way to remove one — Tasks can only disappear as a side effect of deleteProject.

ops.spec: Reassigns a Task from its current Project to a different Project.

tests: moveTask changes target.project to destination and updates both Projects' tasks lists

options.label: Leave both out
options.detail: Both stay implementation concerns outside the shared vocabulary. Cheaper, but it leaves the scenario q-004 flags unresolved: a Project blocked by a Task that can neither be finished nor removed has no spec'd way to become deletable.
